# CHRMP

> CHRMP is India's premier HR certification platform offering specialized professional development courses for HR professionals at all career levels.

CHRMP provides comprehensive HR certifications ranging from foundational courses for beginners to executive-level programs for CHROs. The platform combines blended learning with industry-recognized certifications covering emerging areas like Generative AI, HR Analytics, and behavioral competencies alongside traditional HR domains.

## Key Topics

- HR Certification
- CHRMP Foundation
- HRBP Certification
- HR Analytics
- Generative AI in HR
- CHRO Certification
- Talent Acquisition
- Competency Mapping
- BEI (Behavioral Event Interviewing)
- Learning & Development
- Compensation & Benefits
- POSH Compliance
- Employee Engagement
- Data Visualization
- Professional Development

## Core HR Certifications

- [HR Generalist Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/certification/hr-generalist): Master foundational HR skills including talent acquisition, performance management, and employee relations.
- [HR Foundation Courses](https://www.chrmp.com/hr-foundation-courses): Beginner-level HR training covering compliance, recruitment, and employee relations fundamentals.
- [HRBP Advanced Certification Course](https://www.chrmp.com/hr-advance-certification-program): Strategic HR transformation, workforce planning, and talent management for experienced HR professionals.
- [CHRO Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/chro-certification): Executive-level HR leadership certification covering strategic management and organizational development.

## Specialized HR Skills

- [HR Analytics Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/hr-analytics-certification): Data-driven HR decision-making, talent analytics, and Generative AI applications for HR professionals.
- [Generative AI in HR Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/generative-ai-in-hr-certification): AI-driven HR practices and innovation using cutting-edge generative AI technologies.
- [Generative AI for Recruiters](https://www.chrmp.com/certification/generative-ai-for-recruiters): ChatGPT, prompt engineering, and AI-powered talent sourcing for recruitment professionals.
- [Data Visualisation Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/certification/data-visualisation): Tableau, Power BI, and Excel for creating HR analytics insights and dashboards.

## Talent & Recruitment

- [Talent Acquisition Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/talent-acquisition-certification): Recruitment strategies, sourcing techniques, and selection processes for talent acquisition professionals.
- [BEI Certification Programs](https://www.chrmp.com/bei-certification-program): Behavioral Event Interviewing for competency mapping and evidence-based talent acquisition.
- [Competency Mapping Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/competency-mapping-certification): Job analysis and aligning employee skills with organizational goals and competency frameworks.
- [Talent Development Certification Program](https://www.chrmp.com/talent-development-certification): Learning and development using ADDIE and Kirkpatrick models for talent growth.

## Compliance & Operations

- [POSH Certification Course](https://www.chrmp.com/posh-certification): Prevention of Sexual Harassment certification ensuring workplace compliance and safety.
- [Compensation & Benefits Planning Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/compensation-benefits-planning-certification): India payroll, salary structure design, and compensation architecture planning.
- [HR Operations Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/certification/hr-operations): HR processes, job analysis, and HR dashboards using Excel and operational tools.
- [GCLAP Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/chrmp-gclap-certification): Global Labour Administration & Policy following ILO international standards.

## Learning & Culture

- [CLDP Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/certification/cldp): Certified Learning & Development Professional using Kirkpatrick's evaluation model.
- [Employee Engagement & Experience Certification](https://www.chrmp.com/certification/employee-engagement-experience): Design thinking approaches for building engaging workplace culture and employee experience.

## Promotions & Offers

- [CHRMP Certification at FY-End Pricing](https://www.chrmp.com/chrmp-certification-at-fy-end-pricing): Limited-time pricing on CHRMP certifications including HRBP, HR Analytics, and Generative AI courses.
